pages.text: $(l)Tinkers' Construct$() is about building your own tools. You cast and assemble them from separate parts, each of a different material, then keep modifying them instead of crafting a replacement.$(br2)Its $(l)Smeltery$() melts and alloys metals, and that is the part MC3DPrint has to care about: a Smeltery alloy is not a crafting recipe, so its value cannot be derived.

The alloys, plus cobalt because it is $(l)mined$() rather than crafted.$(br2)$(l)Tier 3$(): steel and slimesteel 25-30 FU, amethyst bronze and rose gold 22, pig iron 24, knightslime and knightmetal 30.$(br2)$(l)Tier 4$(): cobalt 30, queen's slime, cinderslime and soulsteel 45.
pages.title: 16 pinned values

pages.text: $(l)Tier 5$(): hepatizon at 70 FU.$(br2)$(l)Tier 6$(): manyullyn at 130. It alloys cobalt with netherite scrap, so it gates behind netherite-tier filament or down-only printing would launder diamond-tier filament into a debris metal.$(br2)$(l)Tier 2$(): necrotic bone at 15, $(l)wind-only$(). A wither-skeleton farm makes them in bulk, so it is a filament sink and never printable.
